name: Andhra Pradesh
description: Land of the sacred Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, scenic Eastern Ghats valleys in Araku, Gandikota Grand Canyon of India, and historic Buddhist monuments along the Bay of Bengal coastline.

name: Karnataka
description: One state, many worlds: Featuring the Vijayanagara UNESCO ruins of Hampi, coffee hills of Coorg & Chikmagalur, royal palaces of Mysuru, and pristine beaches of Gokarna.

name: Kerala
description: God's Own Country, famed for emerald backwaters, tea plantation hills in Munnar, cliff beaches in Varkala, Ayurvedic wellness, and Kathakali cultural performances.

name: Tamil Nadu
description: Land of ancient Dravidian temples, misty Nilgiri hill stations in Ooty & Kodaikanal, UNESCO Shore Temple Mahabalipuram, rich silk weaving, and vibrant carnatic heritage.

name: Telangana
description: Land of the historic Charminar, Golconda Fort, UNESCO Ramappa Temple, Kakatiya stone gateways in Warangal, and aromatic Hyderabadi Biryani.

name: Goa
description: India's coastal haven of golden sand beaches, Latin Quarter mansions, seafood beach shacks, scuba diving, Dudhsagar Waterfalls, and Portuguese cathedrals.

name: Maharashtra
description: A dynamic state featuring financial capital Mumbai, UNESCO Ajanta & Ellora cave art, Shivaji Maharaj hillforts, Lonavala retreats, and Tadoba tiger reserve.

name: Gujarat
description: Land of the White Rann of Kutch, Asiatic lions of Gir, Statue of Unity, ancient Indus Valley city Dholavira, Somnath Temple, and vibrant Navratri Garba.

name: Rajasthan
description: Land of Kings, renowned for majestic desert hillforts, royal palaces, Thar desert camel safaris, vibrant folk music, and colorful bazaars.

name: Himachal Pradesh
description: The Abode of Snow, home to soaring Himalayan peaks, Buddhist monasteries of Spiti, apple orchards, snow adventure sports, and colonial hill stations.

name: Uttarakhand
description: Devbhoomi (Land of Gods), featuring Char Dham pilgrimage shrines, holy Ganges river ghats in Rishikesh & Haridwar, Jim Corbett tiger reserve, and Naini Lake.

name: Uttar Pradesh
description: Heartland of Indian heritage featuring Taj Mahal Agra, spiritual Varanasi ghats, Ayodhya Ram Mandir, Mathura Vrindavan, and Awadhi royal cuisine of Lucknow.

name: Punjab
description: Land of the Golden Temple in Amritsar, Wagah Border beating retreat ceremony, rich agricultural heritage, vibrant Bhangra dance, and hearty Punjabi cuisine.
foodSpecialties: Makki Di Roti & Sarson Da Saag

name: Haryana
description: Land of the sacred Mahabharata battleground Kurukshetra, scenic Morni Hills, Mughal gardens of Pinjore, and millennium tech hub Gurugram.

name: West Bengal
description: Cultural heartland of India, home to colonial heritage Kolkata, Darjeeling tea railways, Sundarbans mangrove tiger habitat, and UNESCO Durga Puja.

name: Odisha
description: Land of the Sun Temple Konark, Jagannath Puri temple chariot processions, Chilika Lake dolphin sanctuary, and Odissi classical dance.

name: Bihar
description: Cradle of Buddhism and Jainism, featuring the Mahabodhi Temple in Bodh Gaya, ancient ruins of Nalanda University, Rajgir hills, and sacred Ganges ghats.

name: Jharkhand
description: Land of Forests & Waterfalls, featuring Hundru & Dassam falls, Betla tiger reserve, sacred Baidyanath Jyotirlinga Deoghar, and Netarhat Queen of Chotanagpur.

name: Madhya Pradesh
description: The Heart of Incredible India, famed for UNESCO Khajuraho temples, Sanchi Stupa, Kanha & Bandhavgarh tiger reserves, Gwalior Fort, and Mahakaleshwar Ujjain.

name: Chhattisgarh
description: Land of natural wonders and tribal traditions, featuring the Niagara of India Chitrakote Falls, Tirathgarh Falls, Bastar tribal crafts, and Kanger Valley caves.

name: Assam
description: Gateway to the North East, world-famous for Kaziranga one-horned rhinos, Brahmaputra river island Majuli, lush tea gardens, Kamakhya temple, and Bihu dance.
foodSpecialties: Duck Meat Curry with Ash Gourd

name: Arunachal Pradesh
description: Land of Dawn-Lit Mountains, featuring India's largest Buddhist monastery in Tawang, Sela Pass snow heights, scenic pine valley Ziro, and pristine tribal villages.

name: Meghalaya
description: The Abode of Clouds, featuring Living Root Bridges of Cherrapunji, cleanest village Mawlynnong, crystal-clear Dawki Umngot river, and rock music capital Shillong.

name: Manipur
description: Jewel of India, home to the world's only floating national park Keibul Lamjao, circular Phumdis of Loktak Lake, Kangla Fort, and classical Manipuri Raas Leela dance.

name: Mizoram
description: Land of rolling hills and bamboo groves, famous for Cheraw bamboo dance, Reiek cliff viewpoints, Vantawng Falls, blue mountain Phawngpui, and pleasant temperate climate.

name: Nagaland
description: Land of Festivals, famed for the world-renowned Hornbill Festival, green valley treks in Dzukou, Khonoma green village, and 16 colorful warrior tribal traditions.

name: Sikkim
description: 100% Organic Himalayan state crowned by Mount Kanchenjunga, Rumtek monastery, Tsomgo glacial lake, Gurudongmar Lake, and Yumthang Valley of Flowers.

name: Tripura
description: Land of royal palaces and cliff rock carvings, featuring the floating lake palace Neermahal, Ujjayanta Palace, 7th-century colossal rock carvings of Unakoti, and Jampui orange hills.
cultureHighlights: Hojagiri Folk Dance on Earthen Pitchers

name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
description: Tropical archipelago in the Bay of Bengal with Asia's finest Radhanagar Beach, scuba diving coral reefs, historic Cellular Jail, and rainforest island adventures.

name: Chandigarh
description: The City Beautiful designed by master architect Le Corbusier, featuring the world-famous Rock Garden made of recycled scrap, tranquil Sukhna Lake, and Zakir Hussain Rose Garden.

name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
description: Coastal Union Territory with Portuguese fortresses, serene palm-fringed Arabian Sea beaches in Diu & Daman, Naida Caves, and lush tribal forests of Silvassa.

name: Delhi
description: India's historic national capital bridging ancient Mughal empires and modern metropolis, featuring Qutub Minar, Red Fort, Humayun Tomb, India Gate, and Chandni Chowk street food.

name: Jammu and Kashmir
description: Paradise on Earth, featuring Dal Lake Shikaras, Gulmarg world-class ski slopes and gondola, Pahalgam Betaab Valley, Sonamarg glaciers, and Mata Vaishno Devi shrine.

name: Ladakh
description: The Land of High Passes, featuring turquoise Pangong Lake, Khardung La Pass, Nubra Valley sand dunes with double-humped camels, and ancient cliff monasteries.

name: Lakshadweep
description: A secluded tropical archipelago of 36 coral atolls in the Arabian Sea, renowned for crystal turquoise lagoons, untouched coral reefs, scuba diving, and pristine sandy shores.

name: Puducherry
description: The French Riviera of the East, boasting pastel-hued colonial French Quarter villas, Sri Aurobindo Ashram, universal township of Auroville, and tranquil Promenade Beach.
